name: dsh-desktop
description: Delegate to an already running official DeepSeek Harness Desktop through a private local bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to your running DSH Desktop.
interface.longDescription: Delegate to the running official DSH Desktop in isolated task workspaces. Includes the MCP server, setup helper and Desktop adapter. Supports DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 with Cordis 4.0.4, or DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 with Cordis 4.0.5.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my running DSH Desktop for this task. Check setup and connection first, delegate in an isolated workspace, then review the result and changes.
